XRateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests allowed during current short window.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests in current short window.

XRateLimitReset.description: Unix timestamp when short window resets.

ActionFamily.description: Filter action reports by normalized action family.
ActionFamily.name: action_family

ActionKey.description: Filter action reports by normalized action key.
ActionKey.name: action_key

BreakdownDimension.description:
Grouping dimension for breakdown endpoint.
When `dimension=tenant`, rows are grouped by stable `tenant_id`. The
response also includes `tenant_slug` and `tenant_name` as display labels.
BreakdownDimension.name: dimension

BreakdownLimit.description: Number of rows returned by breakdown endpoint.
BreakdownLimit.name: limit

CompareParam.description: Compare current range against the previous equivalent period.
CompareParam.name: compare

ContentInclude.description:
Content response depth. `summary` returns totals and one global UTC
pageview point per day; `limit` has no effect. `full` returns the
detailed Content report. `details` is a deprecated alias for `full`.
When omitted, ranges up to 90 days use `full`; ranges from 91 through
365 days use `summary`.
ContentInclude.name: include

Filters.description:
JSON object serialized as string, example:
`{"device":"mobile","referrer":"google.com"}`.
Filters.name: filters

FromDate.description: Inclusive UTC start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pass explicit from and to dates to bound the requested period.
FromDate.name: from

Metric.description:
Metric to aggregate (default `pageviews`). `sessions` uses the same
visit model as the dashboard: a `visit_id` starts from the
privacy-preserving daily visitor key and is split after 30 minutes of
inactivity.
Metric.name: metric

ReportInclude.description: Report depth for Acquisition and Actions. When report include selection is enabled, omission selects summary; otherwise the handler uses full even when include is supplied. No unconditional default is declared here.
ReportInclude.name: include

ReportLimit.description: Number of rows returned by top lists for report endpoints.
ReportLimit.name: limit

TenantId.description:
Stable tenant identifier. Use this for tenant-scoped analytics and
tenant-scoped access control. `site_id` identifies the shared product,
`tenant_id` identifies one tenant.
TenantId.name: tenant_id

ToDate.description: Inclusive UTC end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to today.
ToDate.name: to

AnalyticsUnavailable.description:
Analytics serving timed out (`ANALYTICS_DB_TIMEOUT`) or is temporarily
unavailable (`ANALYTICS_DB_UNAVAILABLE`).

Forbidden.description: Token scope/site/plan does not allow this request.

HardCapReached.description: Billing hard cap reached for current month.

ReportAvailabilityConflict.description:
The requested route family is not available for the current
`collection_profile`, or the requested period does not contain the
required Extended data envelope.

AcquisitionReportResponse.description: Source response variants selected by the effective Acquisition include mode. Current and comparison use the same shape; availability and metering remain present in every variant.

actions.description:
Exact action rows for the active envelope. On Strict sites, this
list is limited to bounded simple actions and stays readable in
HTTP `200`; advanced families remain section-gated.

action_id.description: Stable element/action identifier when the action row can be narrowed by it.

action_target_host.description: Target host when the action row can be narrowed by outbound or download target.

form_action_path.description: Form action path when the form action row can be narrowed by it.

form_id.description: Form identifier when the form action row can be narrowed by it.

context.description:
Shared breakdown context for the active action envelope. Advanced
action families can remain unavailable even when the route itself
succeeds; inspect `availability.sections`.

families.description:
Family summary for the current action envelope. On Strict sites,
simple bounded families remain available; richer families are
exposed through `availability.sections` as `actions_advanced`.

key.description:
Breakdown key. When `dimension=tenant`, this is the stable
`tenant_id`.

tenant_id.description: Stable tenant identifier for tenant breakdown rows.

tenant_name.description: Current display name for tenant breakdown rows.

tenant_slug.description: Current routing slug for tenant breakdown rows.

ContentReportResponse.description:
Discriminated response union selected by `current.include`. Current and
compare always use the same Content mode.

timeseries.description:
Dense, strictly increasing UTC daily series. It contains exactly
one point per requested day, including zero-valued empty days, and
its pageview sum equals `totals.pageviews`.

plan_id.description: Deprecated compatibility mirror of `product.runtime_plan_id`. The canonical product object is `product`. This field is retained for compatibility and must not be used by new integrations. It remains returned as a deprecated mirror; no sunset date has been announced.

retention_days.description: Deprecated compatibility mirror of `product.product_retention.api_retention_days`. This field is retained for compatibility and must not be used by new integrations. It remains returned as a deprecated mirror; no sunset date has been announced.

cities.description:
Mixed overview audience slice. When unavailable, inspect
`availability.sections` for `overview_cities`.

regions.description:
Mixed overview audience slice. When unavailable, inspect
`availability.sections` for `overview_regions`.

ReportAvailability.description:
Availability contract for profile-aware reads.

For `mixed` routes, HTTP `200` means the strict-safe base slice was
returned successfully. `readModel` tells you which slices belong to
the strict-safe baseline and which belong to `Extended`.
Section-level locks or partial compatibility for enriched sub-slices
are reported in `sections`.

current.description:
Route-level availability for the current range. On `mixed` routes,
`status=available` means the strict-safe base slice is readable;
inspect `sections` for enriched sub-slices that remain locked or
partial.

sections.description:
Section-level availability for mixed routes. Each entry describes
an enriched sub-slice that may remain locked or partially
compatible while the enclosing route still returns HTTP `200`.

ReportAvailabilityReadModel.description:
Explicit read-model for mixed routes. `strictSafe` lists the baseline
slices that remain available in `Strict`; `extended` lists the
enriched slices unlocked by `Extended`.

ReportAvailabilityReadModelSliceId.description: Opaque identifier for a data slice within an availability result.

ReportAvailabilityRouteId.description: Opaque identifier for the route associated with this availability result.

ReportAvailabilitySectionId.description: Opaque identifier for a section within an availability result.

ReportSectionAvailability.description:
Section-level availability for mixed routes. A mixed route can return
HTTP `200` while one or more enriched sections remain locked or only
partially compatible for the requested period.

collection_profile_effective_at.description: Timestamp from which the current site profile applies to future collection. This is prospective only and does not backfill older events.

SurfaceCompareWindow.description: Compare window metadata for report and metrics surfaces.

SurfaceDataFreshness.description: Freshness metadata for a report or metrics surface.

SurfaceExportCapability.description: Export availability for the returned surface and selected plan.

SurfaceMeta.description: Additive launch-readiness metadata for reports and metrics.

tenant_name.description: Current display name from the tenant registry.

tenant_slug.description: Current routing slug from the tenant registry.

top_campaigns.description:
Mixed acquisition section `acquisition_attribution`. May be empty
when the route returns only the strict-safe slice in HTTP `200`.

top_landing_pages.description: Strict-safe acquisition-lite slice available in both Strict and Extended.

top_mediums.description:
Mixed acquisition section `acquisition_attribution`. May be empty
when the route returns only the strict-safe slice in HTTP `200`.

top_referrers.description: Strict-safe host-only referral slice available in both Strict and Extended.

top_sources.description:
Mixed acquisition section `acquisition_attribution`. May be empty
when the route returns only the strict-safe slice in HTTP `200`.

bearerAuth.description:
Bearer token created from Dashboard Settings > API Access.
Scopes:
- `metrics:read` -- access to `/v1/me`, `/v1/sites`, `/v1/tenants`,
  `/v1/metrics/*`, `/v1/reports/*`, `GET /v1/goals`,
  `GET /v1/goals/conversions`, and implicitly grants access to
  `/v1/usage/*`.
- `usage:read` -- access to `/v1/usage/*` only.

info.description:
API-first analytics data plane for customer integrations.
- Strict org isolation based on API token
- Self-serve API plan gating (retention, intervals, quotas)
- Metered usage for analytics reads
- Exact CTA and conversion reporting through the `actions` and `goals` domains
Operation extensions describe the existing access and charging policy:
`x-pomelo-scopes-any-of` accepts any one listed scope, not all of them;
`x-pomelo-metered` marks analytics reads that may consume usage units.
The `metrics:read` scope also grants access to usage reads.
info.title: Pomelo User API

get.description:
Mixed route family. The strict-safe slice exposes channels, host-only
referrers, and landing pages. Attribution slices such as sources,
mediums, and campaigns remain profile-gated. Read
`availability.readModel` for the route split, then inspect
`availability.sections` as `acquisition_attribution`.
When report include selection is enabled, `include` selects the response
depth and omission selects `summary`. Otherwise, `include` is ignored
and the handler uses `full`.
`include=summary` returns `current.channels`, coverage and mix timeseries.
`full` returns `current.by_channel` and top lists. `details` returns
dimensions, landing pages and optional goal impact; it is a distinct
Acquisition variant, not the Content alias for full.

200.description:
OK. Mixed route: the strict-safe acquisition slice succeeded.
`availability.readModel` shows what belongs to the strict-safe
baseline, while `availability.sections` reports whether
`acquisition_attribution` remains locked or only partially
compatible for the requested period.

get.summary: Acquisition channels, referrers, and landing pages

get.description:
Mixed route family. The strict-safe slice covers bounded simple actions
(`ui.click`, `outbound.click`, `file.download`, `form.submit`). Richer
families such as goals, errors, and custom events remain profile-gated
and are marked through `availability.sections` as `actions_advanced`.
Use `availability.readModel` to distinguish the stable baseline from
the enriched families unlocked by `Extended`.
When report include selection is enabled, `include` selects the response
depth and omission selects `summary`. Otherwise, `include` is ignored
and the handler uses `full`.
`include=summary` keeps aggregate families and timeseries and leaves
action/context detail lists empty. `full` and `details` request those
detail rows using the same Actions response schema.

200.description:
OK. Mixed route: the strict-safe bounded action slice succeeded.
`availability.readModel` shows what belongs to the strict-safe
baseline, while `availability.sections` reports whether
`actions_advanced` remains locked or only partially compatible
for the requested period.

get.summary: Simple action report with advanced families gated by profile

get.description:
`summary` supports 1-365 inclusive UTC days. `full` and its deprecated
`details` alias support 1-90 days. Comparison supports at most 30 days
in either mode. Responses are never truncated: if the serialized proxy
response would exceed 5 MiB, the request returns HTTP 422 with
`REPORT_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE` and consumes zero metered units. Detailed
exports beyond 90 days are not provided synchronously by this endpoint.

Mixed route family. In `Strict`, the response still includes the
strict-safe overview baseline plus an acquisition-lite preview built
from channels, host-only referrers, and landing pages. Read
`availability.readModel` for the baseline split, then inspect
`availability.sections` for enriched slices that remain locked.

200.description:
OK. Mixed route: the strict-safe overview slice succeeded. Inspect
`availability.sections` for enriched or geo-detail sections that
remain locked or only partially compatible.
